sources.title: LAMBDA - Legacy Archive for Microwave Background Data Analysis
sources.snippet: LAMBDA is a part of NASA's High Energy Astrophysics Science Archive Research Center (HEASARC). This site is a multi-mission NASA center of expertise for cosmic microwave background (CMB) radiation research; it provides CMB researchers with archive data from cosmology missions, software tools, and links to other sites of interest.
